'''Lanupan security vessels''' were compact [[starfighter]]s designed to escort arriving [[starship]]s to<ref name="SC 105 AD" /> [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]].<ref name="Spa name">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/bj8gqtnvm799njt6mjc6t|text=GR-FF-001420|date=2024-12-23}}</ref> These vessels operated in pairs, each [[pilot]]ed by a single individual.<ref name="SC 105" />

Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> a pair of security vessels escorted the starship<ref name="SC 105" /> of the [[Skeleton Crew]],<ref name="T19XifsgFS0">{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}}</ref> the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]''. Some [[time]] later, another pair attempted to escort a [[Unidentified pirate transport 1|pirate transport]] but were destroyed by a blast from [[Unidentified pirate transport 2|another pirate craft]]. The attacking ships carried [[Silvo's pirates|pirates]] intent on capturing [[Jod Na Nawood]],<ref name="SC 105" /> a member of the Skeleton Crew.<ref name="T19XifsgFS0" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lanupan security vessels first appeared in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," a ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' episode<ref name="SC 105" /> released on [[December 24]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
